title: Memory-Weld Auditor
text: Memory-Weld Auditor compares spoken recollection against a steel archive and removes whatever cannot be reconciled. On loss, suffer 1 Wound.
flavor: Contradiction is treated as a loose component.

defeatReward.text: Memory-Weld Auditor is defeated and its identifying marks are entered into your Trophy Pile.
